Class NamedCircuitBreakerConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.retry.NamedCircuitBreakerConfiguration
@EachProperty("micronaut.retry.circuit-breakers") public class NamedCircuitBreakerConfiguration extends Object
The configuration of a named circuit breaker of the CircuitBreakerRegistry, e.g. 
micronaut:
  retry:
    circuit-breakers:
      orders:
        reset: 30s
        attempts: 1
The retries capture any Exception, as those of @CircuitBreaker do, so that a checked exception is retried and opens the circuit.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
